txt.g3: Not in the wild tables, the Special Encounters doc or an evolution line, so probably not obtainable in Photonic Sun 2.38.
txt.van: Vanilla Ultra Sun (v1.2 game data) compared with the hack's game data (Rebalanced version).
txt.tc: Gen 7 type chart (the hack doesn't change it).
txt.nodc: Not listed in the Move Changes doc.
txt.mvsrc: Type, category, power, accuracy, PP, priority and description from the hack's game data
txt.ns: Not one place, so it has no encounter slot here.
txt.locs: areas in the Wild Pokémon Locations doc's order (roughly when they open up), plus Iki Town for the starter and the places of the Special Encounters doc.
txt.items: Places from Serebii's Ultra Sun item lists (the hack keeps Ultra Sun's overworld items); shops from the Vendor Changes doc. Wild held items are on each Pokémon's page.
txt.walk: Photonic Sun has no walkthrough of its own and follows Ultra Sun's story, so the parts and places are Bulbapedia's Ultra Sun / Ultra Moon walkthrough. Each stop holds its trainers, items and encounters; stops marked "on the way" are encounter areas that walkthrough has no heading for. Tap a trainer to open the team; the Trainers tab has them all.
txt.trh: Sets are the hack's game data (Rebalanced version): species, levels, natures, abilities, items, IVs, EVs and moves. Pokémon with no moves set use their last four level-up moves. Places and order come from Bulbapedia's Ultra Sun / Ultra Moon walkthrough. Speeds use the real IVs and natures{ev}.
txt.trs: Rival teams shown for your {s} starter (set in the Locations or Walkthrough tracker bar).
txt.trs0: Choose your starter in the Locations or Walkthrough tracker bar to hide the other rival teams.
